measures.title: Increase the City of Hudson's annual contribution to the Hudson Area Association Library
measures.summary: Asks whether the City of Hudson's annual contribution to the operating budget of the Hudson Area Association Library should be increased from $400,000 to $450,000.
measures.yesMeans: The city's yearly contribution to the library's operating budget rises to $450,000.
measures.noMeans: The city's yearly contribution stays at $400,000.
